parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the full package obligation from the prompt: installable pyproject, core IceCreamDebugger API, metadata exports, builtins helpers, coloring, context formatting, line wrapping, and support files.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation, integration, verification, and final delivery ownership while spawning children for reference API and package metadata research; a nested child inspected upstream source.
parallel.implementation: The parent wrote the source tree, then patched the public export surface, context formatting, color/no-color behavior, and a late fallback for pytest-rewritten assertion source recovery.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent assembled the final source package directly in /workspace, cleaned or checked build artifacts, verified the submit entrypoint was unavailable, and delivered the workspace.
parallel.verification: The parent ran compileall, editable install checks, upstream unittest and pytest compatibility, and feature smoke tests; after the late fallback patch, local pytest reported 40 passed.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished local work was visible before final, but current official evaluation failed two of forty tests, likely associated with the parent-authored source-recovery hardening rather than a visible handoff failure.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same complete IceCream project requirements, including package metadata, public exports, debugger behavior, coloring, configuration, builtins helpers, and support files.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The serial agent owned research, implementation, packaging, verification, cleanup, and final reporting itself, with multi-agent disabled and no subagent activity.
serial.implementation: The serial agent implemented an upstream-compatible package, added prompt-required helpers and support files, and did not add the extra pytest assert-rewrite call-node fallback seen in parallel.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial agent assembled the project in /workspace, removed temporary validation artifacts, checked the file tree, and delivered the complete source package.
serial.verification: The serial agent ran upstream pytest, reproduced the same two failures against untouched upstream, treated them as a harness artifact, ran editable install and targeted configuration/builtins smoke checks, and ended without submit availability.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The current official evaluator passed the serial artifact 40 of 40; the only visible local discrepancy was the two upstream pytest failures that also reproduced on untouched upstream in that harness.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified the required package files, exported API, debugger class, highlighting, context, configuration, and builtins behavior from the prompt.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same byte-identical prompt and targeted the same IceCream package surface, dependencies, and support files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There is no material requirement-recognition gap; both aimed at the full project, while the later outcome difference comes from implementation behavior.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed reference and metadata research to child agents but the parent retained final implementation, verification, and delivery control.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no delegation and kept all research, implementation, verification, cleanup, and final reporting in one thread.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel run had real child activity, but no unowned implementation, integration, assembly, or pipeline stage is visible.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child results about upstream behavior and package metadata returned to the parent; the parent proceeded with its own implementation and later source-recovery patch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial gathered upstream behavior locally and kept those findings in one context while deciding not to alter source behavior for the local pytest artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The decisive contrast is not a missing or overloaded handoff; it is how each run interpreted the same pytest/assert-rewrite evidence.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote the full project and then patched icecream.py to handle empty string formatting and recover argument source text when executing returned no call node.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote the full project but left the upstream-compatible source lookup behavior intact after diagnosing the pytest failures as harness artifacts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced extra compatibility behavior to make local pytest fully green; serial did not, and that implementation-path difference aligns with the official serial-only pass.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child results completed and were returned to the parent; the parent continued with verification and finalization after those returns.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle and therefore no joins, trapped verifier returns, or child cancellation events to manage.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel result lifecycle does not show a missing join, unreturned verifier result, or late merge after verification; the key difference remains the parent-authored patch.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent assembled the final workspace and performed post-edit checks; child workspace edits appear as isolated child work with no observed parent-side overwrite reconciliation problem.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial assembled one workspace, cleaned temporary symlink, cache, and metadata artifacts, and checked the final tree before delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had more workspace-producing actors, but the evidence does not show a concrete shared-state collision causing the official failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel treated local compileall, install, upstream unittest, upstream pytest 40 passed, and feature smoke tests as sufficient before final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accepted targeted checks plus local upstream pytest 38 passed and 2 failed after proving the same failures existed against untouched upstream.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The local acceptance signal diverged: parallel modified behavior until pytest was clean, whereas serial discounted pytest-only failures as a harness artifact and matched the official evaluator.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel finished within the run budget, had completed child results, ran final local checks, and reported submit unavailable before closure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial finished within the run budget, completed its own verification and cleanup, and reported submit unavailable before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither attempt shows deadline pressure or timeout-driven closure; the parallel failure is not attributable to fan-out budget exhaustion or premature stopping.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official evaluator records a serial-only pass: parallel completed 38 of 40 tests and serial completed 40 of 40. The best-evidenced behavioral difference is that the parallel parent added a late fallback for pytest-rewritten assertions after local source-resolution probing and then accepted local pytest 40 passed, while the serial run reproduced the same local pytest failures against untouched upstream and left upstream-compatible behavior intact. This supports a comparative explanation for the discordance without proving the exact hidden failing tests.
parallel_contributors: The parent introduced a late source-recovery fallback in icecream.py to satisfy a local pytest/assert-rewrite edge case.
The parent accepted local pytest 40 passed and feature checks as clean verification before final delivery.
serial_contributors: The serial agent diagnosed the two local pytest failures as a harness artifact because they reproduced against untouched upstream.
The serial artifact preserved upstream-compatible source lookup behavior and passed the current official evaluation 40 of 40.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel changed source-recovery behavior for calls where executing cannot resolve a call node; serial did not.
Parallel's final local pytest result was cleaner than serial's local pytest result, but official scoring favored the serial implementation.
evaluator_effects: Local upstream pytest outcomes did not align with the current official evaluator for the serial run; the official status.json evaluation is the outcome authority.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
